theme: A caretaking day, one call to close it.
greeting: Today belongs to Mike -- surgery in Portland, then getting him home to recover. The only work is a single call late tonight.

needsAttention.title: Martin at Valoris wants a call
needsAttention.detail: He wrote this afternoon hoping you two can get to know each other given your interest in joining the firm, and floated Aug 25 or 27 -- he's waiting on a time from you.

needsAttention.title: Amra will be in New York
needsAttention.detail: She answered your Sustainalytics question and mentioned she's in NYC September 5-11 and would love to meet in person -- the ball is with you.

schedule.title: Mike's oral surgery
schedule.detail: Portland -- you're driving him home after sedation

schedule.title: IMC research call
schedule.detail: With Chie and Mike, on Teams

flagged.title: A LinkedIn note from Mastercard
flagged.detail: Mastercard's chief government affairs officer sent a connection request.

flagged.title: NACD reception on Sept 15
flagged.detail: The New England chapter asked you to RSVP for their September 15 appreciation reception.

flagged.title: MaineHealth revised an estimate
flagged.detail: The cost estimate for your September 3 visit changed after an insurance update.

inbox.noise: The rest is quiet -- a Venmo summary, LinkedIn job digests, a Maine ferry confirmation, and an Evite reunion thread.

recipe.title: The splendid summer tomato sandwich
recipe.why: Late-summer tomatoes are at their peak right now, so the simplest treatment is the best one.

acts.line: A haircut at ten, then the drive to Portland for Mike's surgery.
The middle of the day is getting Mike home and settled -- he can't drive after the sedation.
One call at nine with Chie and Mike on the next stage of the research, then quiet.
